Question 20

Find (v(t)f(t))′ given that f(t)=⟨2t,2t+1,22t+1⟩ and v(t)=12t.

a
⟨ln⁡2,ln⁡2,(22t−1)ln⁡2⟩
b
⟨0,0,(22t−1)ln⁡22t⟩
c
⟨0,ln⁡2,−ln⁡22t⟩
d
⟨0,−ln⁡22t,0⟩
e
